18.t: Working with data: sharing the voltage
q: State the reading across lamp X in the first test.
Calculate the missing reading for lamp Y.
State the rule these data show for voltage in a series circuit.
The battery voltage is shared: the voltages across the components add up to the supply voltage.
Explain why the lamp with the bigger share of voltage glows more brightly in test 2.
The same current flows through both, but lamp Y has more energy transferred per coulomb (3.8 V), so it transfers more power (P = VI) as light. Y has the bigger resistance.
